messages:
sam: quick heads-up — OptiMed's SI hit a blocker during their private deploy of our marketplace image in an airgapped customer env. Asking for an architecture check and whether we should pause the joint announcement.
alec: can you paste the install log?
sam: here's the failing bit they sent: 
```
Error: manifest validation failed - missing label 'redwood.privateImage'
at pkg/installer/validate.go:87
```
priya: ugh, we added that label last quarter for private images. SI might be using an older image digest or our marketplace metadata webhook didn't run.
mike: side question — did the marketplace publish job complete successfully? It can leave metadata out if sync failed. I can check logs.
tara: if this blocks their private deploys we should consider delaying the joint announcement. Marketing needs a go/no-go by EOD.
sam: OptiMed asked for an architecture review call tomorrow morning; they want a timeline. They already started PII onboarding so this is high priority.
alec: I'll triage the image metadata flow. If it's a publish bug we need a patch + backfill. Assign me the marketplace publish job trace.
priya: tagging the SI contact: @OptiMed-SI — please confirm the image digest you pulled and whether you used the marketplace UI or direct registry pull.
OptiMed-SI: we pulled via the marketplace link. digest: sha256:9f8a... We can standby for the call.
mike: quick check completed — the publish job for that artifact showed a 503 hitting the metadata service at 2023-11-12T22:14:02Z, retry was skipped due to rate limiter. Creating incident ticket.
deploy-bot: created task #MP-3472 (marketplace-metadata-backfill) assigned to alec, due 2023-11-14.
alec: thanks — I'll add a script to backfill the missing label and rerun the registry sync. If successful we can push a hotfix and coordinate a test with OptiMed tomorrow afternoon.
tara: OK — tentatively hold the announcement. Marketing, please prepare a short statement that we can use if announcement slips by >24h.
priya: i'll schedule the arch call and share the playbook for private image validation. Also pinging legal for any contract implications if deployment windows slip.
sam: appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll update OptiMed and set the call for 09:30 PT tomorrow.
OptiMed-SI: thanks — we'll be on the call.
priya: action items recap: alec = metadata backfill + hotfix; mike = incident ticket + logs; priy a = schedule + playbook; tara = pause announcement until signoff.
sam: yep. I'll post progress updates here. :thumbsup:
